groups.name: sso.config
groups.description: SSO token, cookie and interceptor configuration.

properties.name: sso.config.source
properties.description: Configuration source: nacos (default) or local (classpath:${spring.profiles.active}/sso.yml).

properties.name: sso.config.encoding
properties.description: Response and redirect encoding.

properties.name: sso.config.token-name
properties.description: Header name carrying the token and the token field name inside the cookie payload.

properties.name: sso.config.cookie-name
properties.description: Cookie name carrying the token.

properties.name: sso.config.cookie-domain
properties.description: Cookie domain. Empty means current host.

properties.name: sso.config.cookie-path
properties.description: Cookie path.

properties.name: sso.config.cookie-secure
properties.description: Cookie Secure attribute. Required when cookie-same-site is None.

properties.name: sso.config.cookie-http-only
properties.description: Cookie HttpOnly attribute.

properties.name: sso.config.cookie-same-site
properties.description: Cookie SameSite attribute: Lax, Strict or None.

properties.name: sso.config.cookie-max-age
properties.description: Cookie Max-Age in seconds. -1 means browser session cookie.

properties.name: sso.config.cookie-browser
properties.description: Validate the browser fingerprint (SHA-256 of User-Agent) stored in the token.

properties.name: sso.config.cookie-check-ip
properties.description: Validate the client IP stored in the token. Unresolvable IP is rejected.

properties.name: sso.config.trust-forwarded-ip-headers
properties.description: Trust X-Forwarded-For and similar headers when resolving the client IP.

properties.name: sso.config.login-url
properties.description: Login page URL. Empty means return 401 JSON instead of redirecting.

properties.name: sso.config.logout-url
properties.description: Post-logout redirect URL.

properties.name: sso.config.param-return-url
properties.description: Query parameter name carrying the return URL.

properties.name: sso.config.cache-expires
properties.description: Token absolute time-to-live in seconds, also used as cache TTL. -1 disables expiry (not recommended).

properties.name: sso.config.cache-fallback-enabled
properties.description: Allow a degraded local token (no server-side validation) when no GXSSOCache bean is available.

properties.name: sso.config.capacity
properties.description: Maximum entries of the handler-method annotation cache.

properties.name: sso.config.permission-uri
properties.description: Enable URI-based authorization in GXSSOPermissionInterceptor.

properties.name: sso.config.nothing-annotation-pass
properties.description: Allow handlers without a permission annotation when neither URI mode nor annotation mode applies.

properties.name: sso.config.illegal-url
properties.description: Redirect target for a denied request; when blank a 403 response is written.

properties.name: sso.config.sign-key
properties.description: Reserved legacy field. Not used by the current implementation.

properties.name: sso.config.sign-algorithm
properties.description: Reserved legacy field. Not used by the current implementation.

properties.name: sso.config.rsa-jks-store
properties.description: Reserved legacy field. Not used by the current implementation.

properties.name: sso.config.rsa-cert-store
properties.description: Reserved legacy field. Not used by the current implementation.

properties.name: sso.config.rsa-alias
properties.description: Reserved legacy field. Not used by the current implementation.

properties.name: sso.config.rsa-keypass
properties.description: Reserved legacy field. Must not carry a plaintext password.

properties.name: sso.config.rsa-storepass
properties.description: Reserved legacy field. Must not carry a plaintext password.

properties.name: url.white-lists
properties.description: Ant-style path patterns that skip the SSO login interceptor.
